b.x: Anonymous is not unpunished

Anonymity, in this craft, is not handing the biography over for free: the kit, the child, point B, the face as content. It is not erasing the name in front of whoever has the duty. It is not lying on ID. It is not doing harm without a signature. Ethics starts on that line. On one side, privacy — the household file. On the other, impunity — the film. Gray stays on the first. The second is another room, and this guide does not teach the door.
DON'T
Do not use this for fraud, threat, harassment, vanishing from the police, or a false identity. Anonymity that transfers the harm to someone else has already stopped being gray.
Three anonymities that do not mix
01 Of the street — being ordinary. The description fails. You still have a name, ID, a neighbour. Field 88.
02 Of the network — less surface. No pantry photo, no pin, no house in the chat. You still answer for what you publish. The privacy field.
03 Before the law — this one does not exist in the craft. ID. Emergency numbers. The name when authority asks. Gray without paper is suspect; false gray is a crime.
NOTE
Mixing the three is the forum’s error: ‘anonymity’ becomes a vanishing fantasy. Gray ethics separates them. A quiet street. A quiet network. A clear law.
When keeping the name quiet is ethics
Not becoming content. The face, the child, the stock, the route — off the showcase. Whoever refuses to be a stage owes the algorithm no explanation.
Not teaching the house to the stranger. The child’s name, school, window, point B — fridge paper, not the chat.
Not collecting a scene in chaos. Whoever shouts their own name in the hall asks for the tax. Watching and leaving is refusing the stage, not refusing rescue.
A handle on the network, if the land’s law allows, to speak of the craft without handing over the door. A handle is not a false identity at the station.
When anonymity is betrayal
Harm without a signature. Threat, rumour, a false report, harassment. Whoever vanishes after the blow used anonymity against the craft.
Wounded, a lost child, EMS/rescue: a name, a light, a bright cloth. Hiding here kills rescue.
Authority that asks for ID in a legal room: you hand it over. Refusing on ‘philosophy’ is a stage and, often, a crime.
Family. A note on the fridge. Whoever vanishes from the house to ‘go gray’ has already abandoned the first room. Field 88: the myth of the wolf.
The test: where does the harm sit?

One question decides. If keeping the name quiet reduces harm on the house, the child, Tuesday — ethics. If keeping the name quiet pushes the harm onto someone else, onto the victim, onto whoever has the duty to find — betrayal. Ethical anonymity is a shield. Film anonymity is a sword with no owner. The gray man chooses the shield and signs what he must sign.
Network: less trace, the same account
What the network does not need: a photo of the door, the same-hour check-in, geolocation on the kit. Phone and privacy fields.
What the network still charges: what you wrote, the blow, the threat. An account with no name on the profile does not wash the hand.
Data law, a password, the fewest apps — the craft. A forum VPN for crime — another film.
What you sign
01 ID when the law asks. No theatre.
02 The household note: where, until when, with whom. Anonymity for the stranger, a name for whoever waits.
03 The harm you did. Gray is not the excuse of whoever vanishes.
04 Rescue. EMS, fire, police. Name, street, what happened. Here the anonymous delays the pulse.
DO
One less surface on the network this week. The fridge note with a name. ID in the pocket. List: /kits/etica-anonimato. Philosophy: field 88. Privacy and phone beside it.
